# Cross-dataset diagnostic, v0.3 versus v0.3b

Freeze before examining any audio or model outputs. Seek 12 distinct eligible recordings in each of five classes, each ≥4.5 s after decoding. First source choice is published FSDKaggle2018 Acoustic_guitar, Electric_piano or other unambiguously labelled piano recordings, ESC-50 Train and Wind, and official LibriSpeech/LibriVox speech by readers previously unused by this project. Only recorded natural sounds, labelled as such by original curators, and CC0/CC BY or other documented permissive redistribution with attribution. ESC file authors and individual permissions are checked against the originating Freesound pages; ESC-50 annotation/compilation terms are noted separately and original recordings are fetched from their Freesound origin. A catalogue with missing uploader, unverifiable source ID/license, or entries shared by uploader, shared recording ID, or sample hash with the Voice Hunter training, validation or previous tests are ineligible. Upstream encoder pretraining provenance may not be exhaustively verifiable. Distinct source identifiers as well as byte and decoded PCM hashes are mandatory. Use lexicographic SHA256 rank 'VH3b-external-20261121:' plus stable canonical source ID within class, attempting up to 100 items, initially seek one per author, then allow new recordings by otherwise eligible authors if necessary; no reuse across classes. One input recording yields one item regardless of excerpt count. Use one centered 4.5-second sample per recording as the duration under test.

If individual FSDKaggle2018 recordings/metadata cannot be obtained, investigate separately published permissively licensed recordings of these instruments that meet the same conditions; preregister any replacement before inspecting available waveforms or model outputs. Never use per-class web result cherry-picking. Distinguish the class-conditional origins in all reporting. If fewer than 12 usable sources in any class are acquired within this bounded feasibility check, retain the audit and do not issue a fresh 5-class score. When all 5 have 12 eligible recordings, generate balanced deterministic pairs with the fixed Round 3 controlled recipe and rescore both already-locked models on the same requests. This is a new cross-dataset diagnostic, reported separately.
